lines.text: Satan stands at the right hand of Joshua the high priest to accuse him, and the LORD rebukes Satan.
Joshua stands in filthy garments, and the angel orders them to take off his filthy clothes and promises splendid robes.
Zechariah asks for a golden turban on Joshua's head, and they clothe him as the angel stands by.
If Joshua walks in the LORD's ways and keeps His instructions, he will govern His house; the Branch is coming.
The LORD will remove the land's iniquity in a single day, and neighbors will sit under vine and olive tree.
